newsitem.title: USA: Dover sees higher 1997 earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: Dover sees higher 1997 earnings growth.

text.p: Dover Corp said Tuesday its 1997 full-year percentage earnings gain could reach double digits, based on $3.01 per share earned last year (excluding a special gain of $0.44).

The company said it earned $0.89 per share in the second quarter, excluding a special gain of $0.23 arising from the sale by Dover Elevator of its UK and German operations. Earnings a year earlier were $0.78 per share.
Dover said its second quarter earnings exceeded management expectations.
Excluding the second quarter special gain, first half earnings were 9 percent ahead of the first half of 1996, it said.
